title.en: Clinical and laboratory thermometers and air temperature

text.en:
The doctor placed a thermometer under Raju's tongue.
"Your temperature is 37 degrees," she said.

A clinical thermometer measures body temperature, normally about 37 degrees Celsius. It has a kink so the mercury or reading stays and we must shake it down before use.
A laboratory thermometer measures temperatures of liquids, from minus 10 to 110 degrees. We never use it to measure body temperature.
Air temperature is measured in the shade using a thermometer kept away from direct sunlight.

prompt.en: A friend says a laboratory thermometer is used for body temperature. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: A clinical thermometer is for the body.

points.en: Clinical for body, laboratory for liquids.
Air temperature is read in shade.
